description: Schema for updating a detected core service recommendation. This allows users to respond to core service detections by accepting, rejecting, or skipping the recommendation. Users can provide feedback, indicate whether suggested labels were applied, and associate the detected service with a specific workload.

action.description: Accept, skip or reject the core service detection

feedback.description: Feedback from user about the detected core service

labels_applied.description: Indicates if the end user applied the suggested labels for this detected core service

href.description: The workload URI to be associated with this core service recommendation
